result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): A matches the rubric more closely. It lightens the weight a step or uses a lighter grade, opens tracking and line height for small text, and says outright to keep sizes and measure unchanged. It also covers links and code on the dark ground. B has a muddled weight bullet that starts with 'Bump the weight' and then says to drop it. B also recommends a larger size, which contradicts keeping sizes the same, though its coverage of code and links is excellent. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): B matches the rubric more closely. It lightens the weight a step, uses off-white on a soft dark, opens tracking and line height for small text, and says to keep size and measure unchanged. It also covers links, inline code and code blocks on the dark ground. A has good detail, but it contradicts the rubric by suggesting a larger size and a possible weight bump. Its "bump the weight a touch" wording is confusing, even though it later says to drop the weight in a variable font.
